data.gender_notes: Asooda is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'S-D-D', meaning 'to ascend' or 'to rise'. In Islamic contexts, this name is associated with spiritual growth, progress, and overcoming challenges. It is also a reminder of the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) ascension to heaven. The name Asooda carries the meaning “Ascent, Rising” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Asooda usually hope their child will grow to embody ascent, rising and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Asooda belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ascent, Rising.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asooda total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
